verses.text: In the spring, the time of year when kings go off to war, Joab led out the army. He destroyed the land of the Ammonites and went and surrounded the city of Rabbah. But David stayed in Jerusalem. Joab attacked Rabbah and destroyed it.

David took the crown off the head of their king. It was made of about thirty-four kilograms of gold and had precious stones in it, and it was placed on David's head. David also took a great amount of goods from the city.
He brought out the people who lived there and made them work with saws, iron picks, and axes. David did this to all the Ammonite towns. Then David and all his army went back to Jerusalem.
Later, war broke out with the Philistines at Gezer. At that time Sibbecai the Hushathite killed Sippai, one of the descendants of the giants, and the Philistines were defeated.
In another war with the Philistines, Elhanan son of Jair killed Lahmi, the brother of Goliath from Gath. Lahmi's spear had a shaft as thick as a weaver's rod.
In another battle at Gath, there was a huge man with six fingers on each hand and six toes on each foot, twenty-four in all. He was also a descendant of the giants.
When he made fun of Israel, Jonathan son of Shimea, David's brother, killed him.
These men were descendants of the giants in Gath, and they were killed by David and his soldiers.
